Package com.csse3200.game.perks

Class TortoiseFactory

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.perks.TortoiseFactory
public final class TortoiseFactory extends Object
Builds the hidden tortoise collectible entity for the "Time Freeze" perk.

Physics/collider setup mirrors LootFactory: a solid fixture so it can sit on terrain without falling through, and an ITEM-layer hitbox so TortoiseComponent can detect the player touching it. Unlike loot, this uses a static body - a hidden tortoise should never move once placed, not fall or get pushed around.

Visuals come from images/tortoise.atlas (backed by a 144x32 spritesheet), a hand-built atlas over a 144x32 spritesheet (18x16 px cells): an 8-frame "walk" cycle (row 0, unused for now - a hidden tortoise never moves) and a 6-frame "idle" loop (row 1, columns 2-7), which is what actually plays here.

    • createTortoise

      public static Entity createTortoise(String tortoiseId)
      Creates one specific hidden tortoise, ready to be positioned and spawned (e.g. via GameArea.spawnEntityAt).
      Parameters:
      tortoiseId - stable id for this tortoise (e.g. "level1_a") - every tortoise placed in the game needs its own distinct id, so each is tracked and counted separately
      Returns:
      the new tortoise entity

    • isFound

      public static boolean isFound(String tortoiseId)
      Parameters:
      tortoiseId - stable id for a specific tortoise, as passed to createTortoise(String)
      Returns:
      true if that tortoise has already been found - callers (e.g. LevelGameArea) should skip spawning it at all once this is true

    • resetAll

      public static void resetAll()
      Clears every tortoise's found state, so all of them can be found again. Call this on a fresh game start (not a loaded save, not a death/revive) - see MainGameScreen's constructor.
